picks.title: a16z creates a $1.1B 'Machine Age' fund to 'accelerate the physical buildout of AI'
picks.why_it_matters: A major VC doubling down on AI infrastructure signals a thesis shift toward hardware/physical layer startups, creating co-investment opportunities and validating founders building in data centers, chips, and robotics.

picks.title: The EU AI Act gets real
picks.why_it_matters: Enforcement of EU AI regulations will reshape compliance requirements for AI startups seeking European market access, creating opportunities in RegTech and potentially slowing deployment timelines for portfolio companies.

picks.title: Judge blocks Pentagon's Anthropic blacklist
picks.why_it_matters: This ruling reduces regulatory uncertainty for AI startups pursuing government contracts and signals that national security concerns may not arbitrarily block defense-tech market access for frontier AI companies.
